name: threadwave-skill
description: A bilingual, review-gated Twitter/X automation skill suite powered by ThreadWave.

interface.shortDescription: Bilingual, independently versioned Twitter/X peer skills.
interface.longDescription: Install an optional Twitter automation router plus independent post, reply, and daily-agent peers with dedicated ThreadWave preflight and update skills. Every roster skill works in a flat skills directory without Node.js or shell-specific runtime dependencies, and uses one GitHub release index. Missing modules route to /cli/setup/agent.md.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check my Twitter/X automation setup, then route my request to the correct review-gated workflow. 用中文或英文均可。
